name: Possumhaw Viburnum
desc: Possumhaw Viburnum (Viburnum nudum): a plant that turns sunlight into food. Recorded 1 times near the park in GBIF.
about: Viburnum nudum is a deciduous shrub in the genus Viburnum within the family Viburnaceae (it was formerly part of the family Caprifoliaceae). One variety of the species is Viburnum nudum var.
